# Dataview

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An Obsidian query language for filtering, sorting, and extracting data from Markdown pages.

## Scope note

- Obsidian code blocks define Dataview (or DataviewJS) queries that render dynamic content in notes when viewed.
- More generalized features are now available with Obsidian Bases.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Plugin](../ObsidianPlugin/)
